values.note: Park's own 2026 and 2027 rate sheets (identical): on-season (April 15-October 31) basic $15, electric 30A $27, electric 50A $29, sewer/electric/water 50A $35; off-season (November 1-April 14) $14 / $23 / $25 / $29.

fees.source: https://mostateparks.com/sites/g/files/zuston361/files/media/pdf/2026/02/lewis-clark-camping-fees-2027.pdf ('Basic $15 $14', 'Electric - 30 AMP $27 $23', 'Electric - 50 AMP $29 $25', '*Sewer/Electric/Water $35 $29 50 AMP') + CampingFees_LewisClark_26.pdf (same figures), read 2026-11-07. note: Campground beside the oxbow Lewis and Clark Lake, with level, roomy sites. The lake has been dry from prolonged drought since July 2022 (park advisory 'Water Activities Unavailable', still posted 2026-11-07 and running to the end of 2027): no boating, paddling or fishing. --Claude

The lake is still dry (advisory 7/25/2022-12/31/2027): note updated. Pin fine.
